paragraphs: Neḥemyah of Shiḥin testified to R. Akiva, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Sotah 2. A poor man asked him for a chicken; he gave him money to buy meat. He ate and died. Neḥemyah said, 'Lament Neḥemyah's slain,' end of Pe'ah. Bereshit Rabbah 12: R. Neḥemyah of Kefar Siḥin.
